'''Phinea Shantee''' was a patron of the [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Shantee was accused of cheating in a [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] game. A local thug was on his way to break her legs, but an unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] intervened to help. The spacer killed the thug, named [[Chalurrekk]], and returned to Phinea. Thankful, Phinea gave the spacer a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a six-sided [[Chance cube/Legends|die]].

However, Phinea's problems were not yet over. She wanted the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] crime boss killed, so that she could live in peace. The spacer succeeded in killing the Trandoshan, and was awarded with a bottle of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] for his work.

==Behind the scenes==
Phinea Shantee was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. She would give a short series of quests which offered small rewards. She was removed from the game, however, for reasons unknown.
